zh.title: 民航局增開選舉離島航班 2,444個座位11月20日上午9時開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局為因應11月28日地方選舉返鄉需求，協調航空公司增加離島航班運能，11月20日上午9時開放訂位。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月19日表示，為因應11月28日地方選舉的返鄉需求，已再協調航空公司增加離島航線運能，新增20架次運能（含改用較大機型），共提供2,444個座位。
這批座位將於11月20日（週五）上午9時統一開放訂位。民航局建議，若訂不到首選班次，可考慮其他日期或離峰時段。

en.title: Taiwan adds 2,444 seats on offshore island flights for local elections
en.summary: Bookings open at 9 a.m. Taiwan time on November 20 for extra offshore island capacity around the November 28 local elections.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration announced extra capacity on offshore island routes on November 19 to meet demand from voters travelling home for the November 28 local elections. The plan provides 2,444 extra seats across 20 flight movements, including some upgauges to larger aircraft.
Bookings open at 9 a.m. Taiwan time on Friday, November 20. The agency advised passengers who cannot book their preferred flights to consider alternate dates or off-peak departures.

facts.claim: The CAA announced 20 additional flight movements, including use of larger aircraft, providing 2,444 seats.
Bookings open November 20 at 9 a.m. Taiwan time.
The added capacity is for return travel around the November 28 local elections.
